children: Customer experience software firm's Q2 revenue grew 1% yr/yr, slightly missing analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q2 beat analyst expectations
Company cites AI innovation and enterprise adoption as drivers for performance
Sprinklr sees Q3 subscription revenue between $196 mln and $197 mln
Company expects Q3 total revenue between $215 mln and $216 mln
Sprinklr forecasts FY27 total revenue between $866.5 mln and $868.5 mln
AI INNOVATION - Co said pace of AI innovation contributed to Q2 performance, per CEO Rory Read
ENTERPRISE ADOPTION - Co cited increasing enterprise adoption as a driver for Q2 results, per CEO Rory Read
CONTRACTED DEMAND - Growth in remaining performance obligations (RPO) supported Q2 results, per CEO Rory Read
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", 5 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Sprinklr, Inc. is $6.75, about 11.2% below its September 1 closing price of $7.60
The stock recently traded at 15 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 11 three months ago
